subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw expose for keeping failover inside the intended provider or subscription family?
rationale: The issue, comment, and related PR propose different public config semantics, and repository policy treats fallback/config behavior as a product contract with provider-routing and cost implications.

options.title: Choose one canonical contract
options.body: Pick wildcard/auto refs, fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallback, or a deliberate combination before implementation changes schema and runtime behavior.

options.title: Adopt the catalog-derived PR direction
options.body: Sponsor repair of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 as a narrower solution while leaving wildcard/auto and fallbackFamilies for a later design.

options.title: Defer new fallback surface
options.body: Keep explicit flat fallbacks as the only supported contract and close or narrow this feature request after documenting the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical contract
recommendation.body: Pick wildcard/auto refs, fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallback, or a deliberate combination before implementation changes schema and runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest feature-history signal on the central model fallback resolver and related fallback behavior.
